title: Same Tree
statement:
Given the roots of two binary trees `p` and `q`, write a function to check if they are the same or not.

Two binary trees are considered the same if they are structurally identical, and the nodes have the same value.

Build real `TreeNode` trees from both `values1` and `values2`, then compare them recursively.
constraints: The number of nodes in both trees is in the range [0, 100]

editorial.approach: Recursively compare the two trees. If both nodes are null, they match at this position. If exactly one is null, or their values differ, the trees are not the same. Otherwise, recurse on both pairs of left children and both pairs of right children, requiring both recursive calls to return true.
editorial.complexity: O(min(m, n)) time / O(min(m, n)) space
